notes: A library with a single public function (constructTokenURI, 3400 lines) reviewed by structure. 11 source loops: Base64.encode Yul:36 (lost in the aborted tail), HexStrings.toHexString:13 ('while idx > 1', 5 places), toHexStringNoPrefix:23 ('while idx:'), escapeQuotes:88 and :96 ('while uint8(s) < _N', uint8 counters as in the source), NFTDescriptor :320 and :368 ('while temp != 0' digit counts, 'while t:' / 'while uint24(u):'), :219 and :223 (second finding), Strings.toString:21 and :28. The 31 'while idx < _N' are legacy word-wise string copies for abi.encodePacked (P7). Memory locals of the params struct are read as mem[448], mem[541 len 3] etc. (P14/P18). No semantic error seen in the part that was decompiled.
summary: The decompiled part is faithful and its loops are present, but the single function aborts before the SVG assembly, both Base64 encodings and the return, so the text never shows what the token URI is.
